scheme_name: Internship Scheme Of The Department Of Economic Affairs
other_conditions: Must be pursuing a postgraduate or PhD in Economics, Law, Finance, or Management from a university or institution ranked within the top 25 by the National Institutional Ranking Framework or QS rankings
Applicants must register on the MoF‑DEA Internship Application portal of the Ministry of Finance
benefits_summary: Paid remuneration of ₹10,000 per month for postgraduate interns and ₹20,000 per month for PhD interns, along with logistics support and a certificate upon successful completion
application_link: MoF-DEA Internship Application Link of the Ministry of Finance
